description: Budget, consumption, remaining budget and percent used per project over the whole project life, not for a period; for hours or revenue in a period use `mite_report`. Minute budgets are in hours, cent budgets in currency units (consumption = revenue); budget, remaining and percent are null for projects without a budget. Without project_id: all active projects with a budget. Read-only, no paging.

project_id.description: Only these projects: list of mite project ids, e.g. [789]. Default: all active projects with a budget.

name: mite_report_budget
title: Project budgets and their consumption
